start: Owner signed in, gym online, MettleUp Plus switched on for members, gym server has the lock; Settings, Member app tab

steps.action: Scroll to the card 'Free MettleUp Plus for your members'
user_sees: A tick box 'Lock the paid features when a member’s plan ends', ticked
A hint saying the paid features stop 7 days after a plan ends until the member renews, and workouts are always kept
A greyed 'Save' button
A small line saying who changed it last and when, if it was ever changed
must_not: The card shown while MettleUp Plus is off for members
The box unticked while the saved value is on

user_sees: Toast 'Saved. Members keep the paid features after their plan ends.'
'Save' goes grey again
The last-changed line shows today
must_not: The toast when the save failed
The box jumping back by itself

start: Owner on the card; cases where it cannot save or cannot show

user_sees: The button is greyed; nothing happens
must_not: A save and a new last-changed line for no change

steps.action: Change the box and save while the server refuses
user_sees: A red line with the reason under the box
The box keeps what the owner chose
must_not: A 'Saved.' toast
The members' lock changing

steps.action: Open the tab on a gym that is not online, or whose server lacks the lock
user_sees: No card at all
must_not: A card that cannot save
A red error

steps.action: Open the tab when the read of the switch fails
user_sees: No card and no word (the failure is only written to the browser log)
must_not: A card showing a guessed value

user_sees: Toast 'Saved. Paid features lock 7 days after a member’s plan ends.'
must_not: Members whose plan ended yesterday locked at once

steps.action: Untick and tick again without saving
user_sees: 'Save' is grey again because nothing differs from what is saved
must_not: A save with no change

user_sees: The box as saved, with the last-changed line
must_not: The box back to its default

start: Owner saves the lock on; a member whose plan ended 8 days ago opens the app

user_sees: Toast 'Saved. Paid features lock 7 days after a member’s plan ends.'
must_not: A lock earlier than 7 days after the end

user_sees: The paid extras are locked; every saved workout is still there
must_not: Any workout hidden or deleted
A member with a running plan locked
The member asked to pay MettleUp

start: Desk person signed in, gym online, MettleUp Plus on for members, the owner saved the lock on

user_sees: Title 'Settings', subtitle 'Screen colours, app and your sign-in'
Cards 'Dark or light', 'Members', the sign-in card, the install card and the alerts card
The card 'Free MettleUp Plus for your members' is NOT there, so the desk cannot read the lock
must_not: The owner's tick box or 'Save' button
Expected by the card's own desk words but never reached: 'On: paid features lock 7 days after a member’s plan ends.' and 'Only the owner can change this.'

start: Desk person tries to reach or change the lock

steps.action: Type the address of the Member app tab
user_sees: The desk's short Settings again, with no tabs
must_not: The tick box
A 'Save' button
The gym's app code card

start: The owner switches the lock off while the desk person is signed in

steps.action: The desk person opens Settings again
user_sees: The same short Settings; nothing says whether the lock is on or off
Expected by the card's own desk words but never reached: 'Off: members keep the paid features after their plan ends.'
must_not: The desk tells a member the wrong thing because the screen showed an old value
